facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for my cousin Alex.
My cousin Alex graduated with a degree in engineering from college about two weeks ago.
My cousin Alex has been job hunting.
I want a gift that can help Alex with his job search.
I will go with a professional online course or certification as the gift.
I am considering Coursera's Machine Learning by Andrew Ng as the gift course.
Alex has mentioned his interest in machine learning/engineering field.
I am considering gifting the course through Coursera.
I am thinking of purchasing the course as a gift directly from Coursera's website.
I will enter Alex's email address correctly when purchasing the gift course.
I will include a personalized message with the gift course.
I am thinking of reaching out to Alex to check in on his job search.
I am considering whether to give Alex a call or send him a message on LinkedIn.
